license_required.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this chapter, shall practice optometry without a license.

issuing_authority.quote: Board means the board of registration in optometry

name.quote: There shall be a board of registration in optometry consisting of 5 members

type.quote: There shall be a board of registration in optometry consisting of 5 members; including 4 optometrists and one public member

moral_character_required.quote: has presented satisfactory evidence in the form of affidavits properly sworn to, that the person is over 18 years of age and of good moral character

degree_required.value: Bachelor's degree (minimum 2 years college) plus Doctor of Optometry degree (minimum 4 years)
degree_required.quote: has completed a minimum of 2 years at a college of arts and sciences and has graduated from a school or college of optometry approved by the board, maintaining a minimum of 4 years in optometric training

exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO) examination on pharmacological substances
exams.quote: Only licensed optometrists who have successfully completed examinations on pharmacological substances and other treatments of diseases of the eye, adnexa and eyelids

interval_years.quote: All licenses issued under this chapter shall be renewed every two years

required.quote: All optometrists licensed in this state shall be required to take annual courses of study in subjects relating to the practice of the profession of optometry

hours_per_period.quote: The length of study shall be prescribed by the board, with a minimum of 15 hours in a calendar year

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person or persons whomsoever to represent himself or themselves as an optometrist or optometrists unless qualified under the provisions of this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: No person, except as otherwise provided in this chapter, shall practice optometry without a license.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or any offense involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any unprofessional conduct, or dishonorable conduct unworthy of, and affecting the practice of, the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfitness or incompetency by reason of negligent habits or negligent or willful acts inconsistent with health or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unfitness or incompetency by reason of negligent habits or other causes; or negligent or willful acts performed in a manner inconsistent with the health or safety of persons under the care of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction to alcohol or other habit-forming drugs rendering the licensee unfit to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Addiction to the use of alcohol or other habit-forming drugs to a degree which renders him unfit to practice under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical incompetency to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical incompetency to practice under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violation of the provisions of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or repeated violation of the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of a license in another jurisdiction and not reinstated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of a license, similar to one issued under this chapter, in another jurisdiction and not reinstated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of pharmaceutical agents not authorized or not approved by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use of any pharmaceutical agent by an optometrist not authorized under RSA 327:6-a or the use of any pharmaceutical agent other than those agents described in RSA 327:1 or those previously approved by the joint credentialing committee

definition_quote.value: Practice of optometry means the employment of any methods or means, other than surgery, for the diagnosis and treatment of any optical defect, deficiency, deformity, or disease of the human eye, adnexa and eyelids; diagnosis and treatment of any visual or muscular anomaly of the visual system; adaptation or prescribing of spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms or ocular exercises; prescribing, administering or dispensing of pharmaceutical agents; application, prescribing, or removal of FDA approved medical devices; and diagnosis of acute angle closure glaucoma
definition_quote.quote: Practice of optometry means the employment of any methods or means, other than surgery, for the: (a) Diagnosis and treatment of any optical defect, deficiency, deformity, or disease of the human eye, adnexa and eyelids. (b) Diagnosis and treatment of any visual or muscular anomaly of the visual system. (c) Adaptation or prescribing of spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms or ocular exercises for the correction, relief or aid of the visual functions. (d) Prescribing, administering or dispensing of pharmaceutical agents. (e) Application, prescribing, or removal of Food and Drug Administration approved medical devices

value: diagnosis and treatment of optical defects and eye diseases
diagnosis and treatment of visual and muscular anomalies
prescribing spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms, and ocular exercises
prescribing, administering, and dispensing pharmaceutical agents

diagnosis of acute angle closure glaucoma and emergency care
methods_authorized.quote: the employment of any methods or means, other than surgery, for the: (a) Diagnosis and treatment of any optical defect, deficiency, deformity, or disease of the human eye, adnexa and eyelids. (b) Diagnosis and treatment of any visual or muscular anomaly of the visual system. (c) Adaptation or prescribing of spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms or ocular exercises

drug_authority.value: Optometrists authorized to use pharmaceutical agents may prescribe, administer, and dispense pharmaceutical agents including topical agents, mydriatic and cycloplegic agents, miotic agents, antibiotics, anti-allergy medications, anesthetics, ocular lubricants, analgesics (including Class III and IV controlled substances), NSAIDs, anti-glaucoma agents, corticosteroids, antivirals, and vaccines
drug_authority.quote: Pharmaceutical agent means the following pharmaceutical products: (a) Non-legend, over the counter, agents. (b) Mydriatic and cycloplegic agents which are topically applied. (c) Miotic agents approved pursuant to RSA 327:6-a, VI. (d) Antibiotics, sulfonomides, and combinations thereof, which are topically applied or orally administered... (h) Orally administered analgesic agents used for the purpose of alleviating pain caused by a disease or abnormal condition of the human eye or eyelid, or structures posterior to the iris. This may include class III and IV controlled substances approved pursuant to RSA 327:6-a, VI and included in the formulary.

surgery_prohibited.quote: Surgery means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical means. Surgical procedures shall include the use of lasers for therapeutic and photorefractive purposes, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound, or medication administered by injection, provided that the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye, adnexa or eyelid shall not be considered a surgical procedure prohibited by this chapter.

surgery_definition.value: Any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical means, including use of lasers for therapeutic and photorefractive purposes, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound, or medication administered by injection
surgery_definition.quote: Surgery means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical means. Surgical procedures shall include the use of lasers for therapeutic and photorefractive purposes, ionizing radiation, therapeutic ultrasound, or medication administered by injection

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: the removal of superficial foreign bodies from the eye, adnexa or eyelid shall not be considered a surgical procedure prohibited by this chapter. With respect to a foreign body, any part of which is situated within 3 millimeters of the visual axis, 'superficial foreign body' means that which has not penetrated deeper than the corneal epithelium.

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: Anti-glaucoma agents provided that an optometrist may dispense or prescribe such agents if the optometrist has met the requirements of RSA 327:6-c.

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: an optometrist who is certified to use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry shall be permitted to administer: (a) Diphenhydramine, epinephrine, or an equivalent medication administered by injection or other administration route to counter anaphylaxis or anaphylactic reaction.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Adaptation or prescribing of spectacle lenses, contact lenses, prisms or ocular exercises for the correction, relief or aid of the visual functions.

immunization_authority.quote: an optometrist who is certified to use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry shall be permitted to administer: ... (b) Vaccines by injection to individuals 18 years of age or older.

controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: Nothing in this section shall be construed to permit an optometrist to administer any pharmaceutical product by injection; or to administer, prescribe or dispense any pharmaceutical product designated as a schedule I or schedule II controlled substance under RSA 318-B:1-a

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: Orally administered analgesic agents used for the purpose of alleviating pain caused by a disease or abnormal condition of the human eye or eyelid, or structures posterior to the iris. This may include class III and IV controlled substances

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Only licensed optometrists who have successfully completed examinations on pharmacological substances and other treatments of diseases of the eye, adnexa and eyelids, who have met acceptable standards of education and professional competence as determined by the board, and who hold current certification in cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR), shall be authorized to use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry.

value: License with therapeutic pharmaceutical agent (TPA) certification
tiered_license_types.quote: Upon certification to treat glaucoma patients pursuant to RSA 327:6-c, the office shall issue a license to the optometrist with a 'tpa/g' certification.

specialty_certification_types.quote: Only licensed optometrists who have successfully completed examinations on pharmacological substances and other treatments of diseases of the eye, adnexa and eyelids... shall be authorized to use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: To meet the requirements of this section, an approved course shall be given by an accredited school or college of optometry in the United States and shall consist of a minimum of 105 hours, of which a minimum of 25 hours shall be in direct clinical training.

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: an approved course shall be given by an accredited school or college of optometry in the United States and shall consist of a minimum of 105 hours, of which a minimum of 25 hours shall be in direct clinical training.

referral_to_physician_required.quote: Corticosteroids or antivirals, provided that optometrists with patients on corticosteroids or antivirals who demonstrate no improvement in 10 days shall be referred to an ophthalmologist.

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: To be authorized to initiate treatment of glaucoma for patients 18 years of age or older, a therapeutic pharmaceutical agent certified optometrist shall complete the educational requirements in paragraph I and provide evidence of written referrals and consultations with an ophthalmologist.

telemedicine_authorized.quote: Persons licensed by the office of professional licensure and certification shall be permitted to provide services through the use of telemedicine, as defined in RSA 310:7.

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: Unless otherwise specified by the prescriber for health reasons, a contact lens prescription shall expire one year from the date of issue.

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: After contact lenses have been adequately fitted and the patient released from immediate follow-up care by an optometrist licensed under this chapter or an ophthalmologist registered under RSA 329, the prescribing optometrist or ophthalmologist shall, upon the patient's request, provide to the patient a prescription in writing for replacement contact lenses.
